# מיכאל הנדימן — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> Michael Handyman is a friendly, professional home and office maintenance service run by Michael, a solo handyman with a warm, approachable personality. The brand blends trustworthiness with a light-hearted tone ('I'm here to close the corner for you' — an Israeli idiom for 'I've got you covered'). The business emphasizes quality, fairness in pricing, and a smile, with a referral-based promotion (friend brings a friend = 20% discount for both). The site features a tips section positioning Michael as a knowledgeable expert, and a photo gallery showcasing real work.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About מיכאל הנדימן
Michael Handyman is a friendly, professional home and office maintenance service run by Michael, a solo handyman with a warm, approachable personality. The brand blends trustworthiness with a light-hearted tone ('I'm here to close the corner for you' — an Israeli idiom for 'I've got you covered'). The business emphasizes quality, fairness in pricing, and a smile, with a referral-based promotion (friend brings a friend = 20% discount for both). The site features a tips section positioning Michael as a knowledgeable expert, and a photo gallery showcasing real work.

## Target Audience
- homeowners and office managers needing repairs and maintenance
- בעלי בתים הזקוקים לתיקונים
- מנהלי משרדים לתחזוקה
- בעלי בתים חדשים

## Industry
Home Services / Maintenance & Repair
